ideas.text: An AI that books a meeting to discuss whether this could have been an email.
A bot that cancels your recurring meeting the moment someone adds an agenda item.
An app that detects when a 'quick sync' hits 47 minutes and hangs up on everyone.
A tool that reschedules your meeting to discuss rescheduling the previous meeting.
An AI that blocks focus time and then fills it with meetings about protecting focus time.
A meeting room booking system that automatically double-books the good room every Tuesday.
An app that sends a 'great meeting!' summary even when absolutely nothing was decided.
A bot that mutes late joiners for exactly as long as they were late, to the second.
An AI that converts every action item into a follow-up meeting to discuss that action item.
A tool that calculates the combined salary cost of your meeting and displays it on screen in real time.
An AI that reschedules your standup because two people have a conflict with the standup.
A bot that forces everyone to stand during standing meetings by disabling chairs via IoT.
An app that detects when 'let's take this offline' was said and schedules the offline immediately.
A tool that pre-writes your 'per my last email' follow-up the moment a meeting summary goes ignored.
An AI that detects when a meeting has no owner and assigns it to whoever spoke last.
A calendar optimizer that creates one 90-minute focus block per week and defends it like a war crime.
An app that sends a gentle notification when your 3pm meeting is the 9th consecutive call of the day.
A bot that joins meetings 8 minutes early and hums softly until everyone arrives.
An AI that detects when a meeting is actually a status update and converts it to a Slack message mid-call.
A tool that archives your recurring meeting after 3 consecutive cancellations and sends a funeral notice.
An app that counts how many people in a meeting are also on their phones and displays the ratio to the presenter.
An AI that predicts whether the 'pre-read' will be read by anyone and adjusts the meeting length accordingly.
A bot that adds 'this could have been an async loom' to every calendar invite it reviews.
A meeting note taker that only records when someone sighs, shifts in their seat, or checks Slack.
An AI that detects when a parking lot item has been parked for 3+ meetings and files a missing persons report.
A tool that automatically extends meeting invites by 15 minutes because everyone knows they run long anyway.
An app that blocks Tuesday afternoons company-wide after detecting that nothing has ever been accomplished in one.
A bot that sends 'can you send a summary?' to anyone who missed a meeting they weren't invited to.
An AI that replaces 'let's align on this' in meeting notes with the actual decision that should have been made.
A tool that detects when an all-hands has more slides than minutes and sends a triage alert to the presenter.
An app that lets you add 'optional' to a meeting and tracks who gets punished for actually not attending.
A bot that joins every call 3 minutes in and asks 'quick question — can we level-set on the goal here?'
An AI that classifies your meeting by type: decision, status update, therapy, or vibes check.
A tool that detects when a 'working session' has produced no work and retroactively reclassifies it as a meeting.
An app that counts the number of times 'does that make sense?' is said and bills the speaker per instance.
A meeting room occupancy monitor that sends a passive-aggressive email when the room smells like lunch.
An AI that rewrites meeting titles from 'sync' to an honest description of what actually happens in them.
A bot that schedules a 30-minute retrospective after every 30-minute meeting, recursively, until IT intervenes.
An app that flags when a meeting has 14 people and only 2 of them ever speak.
A tool that detects 'can we loop in X?' and immediately adds X without asking, then schedules a new meeting.
An AI that automatically declines meetings scheduled during lunch by people who do not eat lunch.
A bot that makes a sound effect every time someone says 'moving forward' in a meeting.
An app that estimates how long a meeting will run based on who is in the room and displays a confidence interval.
A tool that identifies the one person whose presence made a 12-person meeting necessary and pings them directly instead.
An AI that detects when someone said 'I'll be brief' and starts a countdown timer visible to all attendees.
A bot that bans the phrase 'quick check-in' after 3pm on Fridays and returns a 418 error.
An app that detects when a meeting has ended but nobody has left yet and plays exit music.
A tool that measures the silence after 'any questions?' and scores presenter credibility inversely to its length.
An AI that predicts, from calendar data alone, which meetings this year will produce an org chart.
A meeting host that automatically unmutes the one person who has been on mute trying to speak for 4 minutes.
An app that sends 'the invite said 30 mins' as a push notification at the 31-minute mark.
A bot that detects when the meeting is just one person screen-sharing a spreadsheet and offers everyone an exit.
An AI that detects 'we should set up a meeting about this' said inside a meeting and awards a recursion badge.
A tool that calculates how many times a decision was 'tabled' before it finally got made and graphs the delay.
An app that adds 'see you in three weeks' to every calendar invite that involves a person who travels.
An AI that detects when a meeting is being held because nobody wants to make a decision alone and names it accordingly.
